day.headline: A Goat day — Rabbit and Pig are in step.

reasons: Horse pairs with Goat — a harmonious day
signs.message: Get up after eating and walk the long way home.

reasons: Goat's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Take the good mug. Say it's yours if anyone asks.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Claim the last slice. Standing over the box counts.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a dinner that took too long
signs.message: Let dinner run long tonight. Nobody's timing you.

reasons: Pig and Goat share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the good idea written on a receipt
signs.message: Find that receipt and type the idea somewhere real.

reasons: Snake sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Guard the empty Saturday. One errand, then back to nothing.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Move the appointment now, before the reminder guilts you again.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the second half of the day
signs.message: Do the real thing after lunch, not before.

reasons: Rabbit and Goat share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: a coat with something in the pocket
signs.message: Go through last winter's coat pockets. Free indoor entertainment.

reasons: Ox opposes Goat — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: a park with one good bench
signs.message: Walk to the one good bench and achieve nothing there.
